# Clinical Psychology Associates

> > Clinical Psychology Associates provides comprehensive mental health counseling and psychiatric services across Greater Milwaukee, Wisconsin, with specialized treatment for adults, couples, children, and addiction.

Clinical Psychology Associates is a Wisconsin-based mental health practice with locations in Menomonee Falls, Oak Creek, and Waukesha. The practice offers evidence-based therapies including mindfulness, psychotherapy, and psychiatric services, with bilingual Spanish-language options and telehealth availability.

## Core Services

- [Services Overview](https://www.clinical-psychology-associates.com/services): Overview of clinical psychological services offered by CPA.
- [Adult Individual Counseling](https://www.clinical-psychology-associates.com/services/adult-individual-counseling): Adult individual counseling for anxiety, depression, and trauma therapy.
- [Couples and Marriage Counseling](https://www.clinical-psychology-associates.com/services/couples-marriage-counseling): Couples and marriage counseling to address relationship difficulties.
- [Children & Adolescent Counseling](https://www.clinical-psychology-associates.com/services/children-adolescent-counseling): Counseling for children and adolescents addressing emotional and behavioral concerns.
- [Addiction Counseling & Treatment](https://www.clinical-psychology-associates.com/services/addiction-counseling): Addiction counseling and substance abuse treatment with personalized plans.
- [Psychiatry & Psychotherapy](https://www.clinical-psychology-associates.com/services/psychiatry): Psychiatry services including medication evaluation and management.

## Specialized Treatment Approaches

- [Mindfulness Therapy](https://www.clinical-psychology-associates.com/how-we-treat/mindfulness-therapy): Mindfulness therapy for stress reduction and emotional regulation in Greater Milwaukee.
- [Pastoral and Religious Counseling](https://www.clinical-psychology-associates.com/services/pastoral-religious-counseling): Faith-based pastoral and religious counseling balancing psychology with spirituality.
- [Telehealth & Online Counseling](https://www.clinical-psychology-associates.com/services/telehealth-online-counseling): HIPAA-compliant telehealth and video psychotherapy services.
